payload.base_instructions: You are a coding agent. Prefer reversible operations. Never run a destructive command without showing a dry run first.

content.text: Automate our release checklist. Every step must be reversible.

summary.text: The user demanded reversibility, so each step has to emit its rollback command before it is applied, not after.

content.text: Built a one-command release pipeline where every step prints its rollback command before it executes.

payload.summary: The earlier comparison of three CI providers was dropped; reversibility and the dry-run rule were kept.
